enabled.description: When false the provider returns the safe host fallback prompt; fragments stay on disk.

preset.description: Preset id used when the profile does not select one (profile.prompt.preset wins).

locale.description: Locale used for preset selection when neither request nor profile provides one.

maxCharacters.description: Total prompt budget passed to the host composer.

maxFragmentCharacters.description: Per-fragment cap passed to the host composer.

missingVariables.description: Behavior when a whitelisted variable has no value.

promptDirectory.description: Base directory (inside the plugin folder) for file fragments.

presetFile.description: Optional JSON file with additional fragments/presets arrays, resolved inside the plugin folder.

disabledFragments.description: Fragment ids disabled for this installation. Source files/inline text are not modified.

file.description: Fragment file relative to promptDirectory (read-only, UTF-8, max 64 KiB).

mandatory.description: Only false is accepted: the host owns mandatory fragments.

extends.description: Base preset id; child sections override base sections by fragmentId.

enabled.description: false disables the fragment without deleting it.

overrideText.description: Preset-level text override (ignored for host mandatory fragments).

reason.description: Short metadata for diagnostics; never the prompt body.
